title: Authority v6 per-outcome grading record for the code domain
description: The runner has stamped schema_version code-grade-record-v1 on these rows since c005, but no schema by that name existed anywhere in the repository. These rows carry u0, u1 and u2 — the measurements every Gate result is computed from — so they were the least shaped and the most load-bearing records in the run. Written from what scripts/run_c005_gate0.py emits and what scripts/bigcodebench_grade.py returns, and checked against the archived c006 grades. Identity fields are not pinned to one condition, for the reason recorded in g_record_single_v3.

status.description: model_invalid means no usable program was recovered, which is also how a deferred rewrite resolves. grader_error is a pipeline fault and nulls u; protocols/authority_v5/README.md section 5 refuses to validate a run on top of one.
